Sentence (English): We had a Bosch dishwasher and replaced it with this GE dishwasher when we remodeled the kitchen (we replaced all our appliances with the GE Profile series).
Comments (English): [ Prefer our old dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We had a Bosch dishwasher and replaced it with this GE dishwasher when we remodeled the kitchen (we replaced all our appliances with the GE Profile series). I do not like the exposed drying/heating elements in the bottom of the dishwasher. Many of our taller glasses, pans, and utensils do not fit in this unit without adjusting the height down, which then results in the spinning water arms from turning because they hit the plates or other things. We used to fill the Bosch over a period of a few days, but with the GE unit, we end up running it almost every day with fewer items so we don't have issues with the water arms hitting dishes. We've also noticed that the dishwasher pods do not always dissolve, which results in a paste inside the pod dispenser. Our glasses are becoming very cloudy very fast with this dishwasher, too. There are many features that might be ok, but we don't really use any of them. One of the things I do like about this dishwasher is the ability to connect via wi-fi to get an alert when it finishes (this was an add-on module). It is better with fingerprints and smudges than our old dishwasher.

Have had to address two separate issues, one of which was a selling feature. (1) Auto dishwasher door opener - stopped working by third use. This has required my running dishwasher twice. Once in hopes that it will finally work (I've ensured issue isn't due to powder detergent collecting in crevices). Second time manually opening cavity. Because of these two issues occurring in such a short period since purchase, I would NOT recommend Samsung products. We've had issues with a Samsung refrigerator (faulty, non-functioning ice maker within one year of purchase). I appreciate the friendly and professional customer service, but such issues happening soon after $1000 purchase is unacceptable. Spend your money elsewhere.

Sentence (English): After the first few weeks of ownership we started noticing the dishwasher would attempt to drain, repeatedly, and then just shut down.
Comments (English): [ Does not drain properly ] || ---------------- || After the first few weeks of ownership we started noticing the dishwasher would attempt to drain, repeatedly, and then just shut down. Upon opening the door, there would be standing water at the bottom, but with little to no food particles. The drain hole is smaller than my pinky. This junk will just randomly refuse to finish draining, and then quit the cycle. There is no food blocking the drain. There is nothing in the air trap. I even tried replacing the drain pump. You will come back to the machine just sitting there off, with wet dishes inside and 2 inches of water. Then, I'll start the dishwasher to force it to drain, and it will drain no problem. I have repeated this stupid frustrating cycle over and over and over, and as soon as I replace my countertops I am throwing this junk in my yard and putting holes in it. I have had to pull this thing out 3 or 4 times, even damaged some of my counters because the feet are bent and won't screw in/out properly to raise/lower for clearance. Why the heck is the drain hole the size of a corn kernel? Why the heck will it just randomly not drain, and then suddenly it will as soon as I force it to try again? I also bought a GE stove and trying to replace the light bulb inside the freaking wiring broke and now my stove has no light. GE appliances are absolute trash now - I bought them because my grandparents worked there years and years ago, but clearly they are no different than any other big company who used to be American.

Overall: It does the job and fit our budget, but I was expecting a little more in terms of performance, design, and build quality. I will also note that the price has increased since we bought it.

It doesn't dry the dishes very well, even when we use a drying aid as instructed in the manual. The utensil basket has holes that are too small for most of our pretty standard-sized flatware. The bottom rack isn't really constrained on tracks or anything, so it does not roll smoothly in and out of the dishwasher. The top rack is too shallow for some of our drinkware, such as wine glasses. The buttons don't fit the faceplate very well, so they easily stick during use. The plastic countertop looks, well, like a big piece of plastic, and is difficult to keep clean due to its texture. The water hose doesn't retract neatly into the back of the dishwasher - it sticks out from the back, despite there appearing to be a nook for it to rest in. Overall: It does the job and fit our budget, but I was expecting a little more in terms of performance, design, and build quality. I will also note that the price has increased since we bought it.

Sentence (English): Needed portable dishwasher as was spending too much time cleaning up kitchen everyday.
Comments (English): [ A real time saver ] || ---------------- || Needed portable dishwasher as was spending too much time cleaning up kitchen everyday. Even though only two people in household, cooking nearly everyday dirtied alot of dishes and pots and pans. The large size (12 place setting version) accommodated the daily cooking mess well. Wash dishes at least every other day, although dried on food cleans better if not left for two days. Only comment is that I wish the owners manual would include tips for washing pots and pans. There was learning curve here on what to put where for best results, but you probably have to learn that with any dishwasher. My only worry is that the adapter hose connector will wear out over time. Not sure how it would be replaced. Please note that you need a good sink faucet with no spray adapter to work the machine. The dishwasher water pressure will cause the spray adapter to burst and the faucet will leak at the base if it's of low quality. Using bathroom sink for now until I get a new faucet installed in kitchen. Hope I can find one or modify one so the spray attachment has a on/off valve.

Comments (English): [ Durability problems. Worst-ever delivery & install ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher washes well, is very quiet, and dries about the same as all newer un-heated dry cycle machines. The racks and their slides are disappointing though. There's a lot of slop in the slides and the racks can get wedged at weird angles. I worry this will lead to early failure if a rack gets wedged almost-in and the washer door gets shut on it. What was downright awful though was the delivery and install process. The first unit we ordered was delivered to the wrong address. It was then shipped back to Costco instead of delivering it to us. Costco immediately refunded us, but we had to re-order which restarted the time to get a new dishwasher. That second unit took over a month to be in-stock (even though one just like it was apparently down the street from us at the start of the month). Once it was in-stock the delivery and install was rescheduled 3 times. This was especially awful because it kept happening just the day before or morning of install. On the 4th delivery attempt, the installer actually showed up when scheduled. But they didn't have a mounting bracket and complained the hose that came with the washer was too short. A bracket and long-enough hose seem like things the installers should have in their vans . but no. Instead we waited 3 more weeks for the installers to come back again. The total delivery & install time is now 2 months, plus a moth of waiting on the unit to be in-stock. Of course, after 3 more weeks of waiting on a 5th delivery attempt, the installers rescheduled delivery again. A week later they actually showed up for delivery attempt #6. Without the dishwasher! This time, the installers did agree to go back to their depot and get the dishwasher. So the 6th install did finally work out. But after months of waiting on delivery it's hard to be anything but disappointed in Costco's "free delivery and install". I guess we got what we paid for.

Sentence (English): All of the dishwasher's claims are correct!
Comments (English): [ Washes dishes perfect, but not for deep dishes ] || ---------------- || All of the dishwasher's claims are correct! It washes and dries perfectly, per whatever settings I choose. I love all of the options for washing, drying, sanitizing, and even choosing (or not) the bottle jets. All of my dishes and utensils are always cleaned & dried perfectly. I also appreciate the adjusting top rack (up or down), depending on whether I have tall items on the top or on the bottom. However, I didn't pay attention to how close together all of the tines are on both the top and bottom racks. We have deep bowls and they cannot fit down in between the tines at all. The angle at which the bowls have to sit, in order to fit down between the tines, causes them to take up at least two spaces, usually three. We could put the bowls in the rows between the tine rows themselves, but then it really reduces how many items can be placed into the rack(s). I also found I had to completely remove the silverware basket on the bottom rack, so I could have a wider gap to place my larger pans and casserole dish. Larger pans will not fit between the regular tines, unless they are shallow pans. If I try to slide a pan between the tines, it will need to be angled. Therefore, depending on how big the pan is, it'll hang/angle over a bunch of tines, which reduces how much can actually be put in the rack. The pan could be placed in a row between the tine rows themselves, but that reduces how many items can be placed into the rack. Lastly, there is a row of tines that can adjust/lay down on the bottom rack, but doing that makes a huge space (and I haven't figured out when I would need that much flat space, without the item(s) moving all around). And, of course, when that row of tines is adjusted, it reduces how much can be put on the bottom rack. All of that to say, I have adjusted/learned how to put things in my dishwasher. I do love how well it cleans and dries everything, which is the main purpose of a dishwasher! But I will have to admit that every time my bowls take up three slots because they can't fit in-between the tines, a small part of my organizational-self dies.

Sentence (English): All of the dishwasher's claims are correct!
Comments (English): [ Washes dishes perfect, but not for deep dishes ] || ---------------- || All of the dishwasher's claims are correct! It washes and dries perfectly, per whatever settings I choose. I love all of the options for washing, drying, sanitizing, and even choosing (or not) the bottle jets. All of my dishes and utensils are always cleaned & dried perfectly. I also appreciate the adjusting top rack (up or down), depending on whether I have tall items on the top or on the bottom.However, I didn't pay attention to how close together all of the tines are on both the top and bottom racks. We have deep bowls and they cannot fit down in between the tines at all. The angle at which the bowls have to sit, in order to fit down between the tines, causes them to take up at least two spaces, usually three. We could put the bowls in the rows between the tine rows themselves, but then it really reduces how many items can be placed into the rack(s).I also found I had to completely remove the silverware basket on the bottom rack, so I could have a wider gap to place my larger pans and casserole dish. Larger pans will not fit between the regular tines, unless they are shallow pans. If I try to slide a pan between the tines, it will need to be angled. Therefore, depending on how big the pan is, it'll hang/angle over a bunch of tines, which reduces how much can actually be put in the rack. The pan could be placed in a row between the tine rows themselves, but that reduces how many items can be placed into the rack. Lastly, there is a row of tines that can adjust/lay down on the bottom rack, but doing that makes a huge space (and I haven't figured out when I would need that much flat space, without the item(s) moving all around). And, of course, when that row of tines is adjusted, it reduces how much can be put on the bottom rack.All of that to say, I have adjusted/learned how to put things in my dishwasher. I do love how well it cleans and dries everything, which is the main purpose of a dishwasher! But I will have to admit that every time my bowls take up three slots because they can't fit in-between the tines, a small part of my organizational-self dies.

Sentence (English): I am very happy with the purchase of our Bosch 100 series dishwasher with the third tray for silverware.
Comments (English): [ I am very happy with the purchase of our Bosch.  ] || ---------------- || I am very happy with the purchase of our Bosch 100 series dishwasher with the third tray for silverware. It is so quiet, you can't hear it run unless you're standing next to it we run it on auto, extra dry. It cleans pots and pans good, dishes and silverware come out good too. My only complaint is that plastic containers don't dry so well, even using extra dry mode. Before running our old (loud) dishwasher, we would run the faucet until the water got hot, which wasted 3-4 gals of water, and gas for the water heater. Now I don't waste any water or gas to preheat. We let the new dishwasher heat up its own water (electrically). We have solar, so it's cheaper than gas for us.

Sentence (English): First, I'll say that I'm not difficult to please in terms of a dishwasher -- I've literally never been displeased with any working dishwasher I've ever had in any apartment or in my own home.
Comments (English): [ Very disappointed in this dishwasher & in Lowes ] || ---------------- || First, I'll say that I'm not difficult to please in terms of a dishwasher -- I've literally never been displeased with any working dishwasher I've ever had in any apartment or in my own home. I'm perfectly happy with a basic-basic dishwasher. However, this is the worst dishwasher I've ever owned, and I'm sick at heart thinking I'm going to have to live with it for a decade or more. Pros -- in all honesty, some things about it are positive: - It really is quiet, which I appreciate in an open floor plan. - I love that it contains two small silverware bins, which means I have the option of using just one /fitting in more dishes. - It was available. In these post-pandemic days, appliances are hard to get; this was my third choice dishwasher, as the ones I really wanted were not available. Negatives: - The tines in the dishwasher are small, close together and angled oddly. The tines are divided into three portions, and I haven't figured out why. These oddly-placed tines work for thin dishes (not my Fiestaware), but casserole dishes do not load at all -- I'm forced to wash those by hand. - The dishwasher cleans plates and bowls well, but frying pans come out still obviously dirty. I think this is related to the odd-tines thing; that is, the frying pans can't be placed to hit the spray appropriately. - This dishwasher holds about 2/3 as many dishes as previous machines I've owned. - I was excited about the "fold down bits" on the top shelf, but it turns out they don't really do anything. Why include a feature that does nothing? - The dishwasher has an on switch, then a second switch to start the load. When the load ends, the on switch does not turn off automatically, and since I tend to run a load of dishes around the time I go to bed, this means the dishwasher stays "on" all night. I fear this will lead to wearing out before its time, which might not be the worst thing.And a few notes on Lowes: - I purchased this dishwasher in December, and I accepted that appliances today in the post-pandemic world aren't available like they used to be, so I wasn't particularly surprised when they said it'd be January 16th (this meant waiting 4 weeks, and -- obviously -- the holidays fell in that time frame) before the could install. - After I had made the purchase, Lowes told me they wouldn't be delivering /installing the dishwasher themselves; rather, they contract that job out. I had a bad experience with a third-party delivery team some 15 years ago, and I expressed concern about this, but Lowes assured me they stand behind their delivery people 100%, and nothing would go wrong. - On January 14th Reliable (the poorly named delivery company -- by the way, this is Concord, NC) called to say they'd deliver my dishwasher mid-February. I called them back immediately to let them know this was unacceptable, as I'd be starting a new job and didn't want to take off the first week. - The phone receptionist made it crystal clear to me that Reliable could not have cared less whether this new date was convenient for me. When I asked why the date was changed, she told me the dishwasher was sitting in the warehouse, and she didn't know why the date was changed. - I headed to Lowes, feeling quite sure they would take care of the problem for me. They promised me they'd fix the problem, and I went home and waited for a phone call that didn't come. - Over the course of the next week, I physically went to Lowes four more times, speaking to more and more people -- at one point when I was ugly crying out of frustration, the teenaged cashier gave me a Kleenex and said she was sorry I was in this situation -- she was the ONLY person at Lowes who seemed to care about their lack of follow through. At no point did anyone from Lowes (Concord, NC -- Bruton Smith Blvd) call me back, though assistant manager Ryan did have the grace to look embarassed when he was called out to see me for a second time -- he knew he'd done nothing with my problem earlier in the week. - In the end, I did take off from my new job /did lose money, and my dishwasher was installed in February (remember, I bought it in December). The Reliable delivery company may be impossible to schedule, but their installation was good -- the dishwasher was 1/4" larger than standard, and they managed to make it fit. - Lowes also sold me a small item necessary for installing a dishwasher under a granite countertop, though I do not have granite countertops. $13 wasted. In conclusion, I am extremely frustrated with this second-rate dishwasher and the purchasing process. I will never buy another Bosch appliance, and (although Lowes has sold me most of my appliances in my 34 years of home ownership) I will never buy an appliance from Lowes again.

Sentence (English): I would probably rate this about 3.5 stars.
Comments (English): [ Get the Whirlpool ] || ---------------- || I would probably rate this about 3.5 stars. I was trying to decide between this one and a Whirlpool model that was about $100 cheaper. I chose this for the zoned washing because at some point in my life this was something I thought I needed. Unfortunately, those days seem to have passed because I have yet to use that feature. Doh! Otherwise, the machine is louder than I expected, though quieter than the junky 20-year old GE it replaced. The plastic accessories inside are junky with pieces constantly popping off, which then have to be reattached with each use. It doesn't impact function, but is pretty annoying. The touch panel can be finicky since there are no clear buttons to push so I sometimes find myself fumbling to get the machine running. On the pros side, the racks are large and can accommodate a lot of stuff and we haven't had issues with dishes not being clean. Plus, it has a super cute end of cycle chime that reminds me of a Tomagotchi. But if I had to do it over, I would've purchased the Whirlpool instead.

Finish® Quantum® Automatic Dishwashing Detergent has been approved for use in all GE Appliances dishwashers. To remove suds from the tub, open the dishwasher and let suds dissipate. Reposition the dishes, so the water from the lower spray arm can flush the detergent cup. See the Loading section. Reposition the tall utensils or heavy silverware that may be keeping the dispenser cup door from opening. See the Loading section. Don't place large bowls or pots directly under the detergent dispenser. Remove marks with a mild, abrasive cleaner. Make sure inlet water temperature is at least 120°F. Select Heated Dry. GE Appliances recommends Finish® Jet-Dry® Rinse Aid to help prevent hard water mineral deposits from forming. Run dishwasher with citric acid to remove mineral deposits. Citric acid (Part number: WD35X151) can be ordered through GE Appliances Parts. See back cover for ordering information. Alternatively, purchase Finish® Dishwasher Cleaner and follow the directions on the label. Replace fuse or reset circuit breaker. Remove any other appliances from the circuit. In some installations, the power to the dishwasher is provided through a wall switch, often located next to the disposer switch. Make sure it is on. Unlock control panel. See the Getting started section. Some models are equipped with leak detection and the cycle will be cancelled if a leak is detected. The display will show “LEAK DETECTED”. Call for service. See ty”. Now we are faced with the unfortunate situation of choosing whether to repair the control board for $350-$400 or just replace this appliance for $900-$1000. It's very upsetting and frustrating.

Sentence (English): I bought this GE dishwasher to replace an old 1980's GE dishwasher, thinking that any modern dishwashing couldn't be worse than a 30+ year old one.
Comments (English): [ Low quality material and weak cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I bought this GE dishwasher to replace an old 1980's GE dishwasher, thinking that any modern dishwashing couldn't be worse than a 30+ year old one. I guess it's true that they don't make them like they used to. Most of the components are plastic and they fit together very smoothly. Since this was a big change in technology, I found that my utilities were out of the date. When the delivery guys came, they looked under the sink and said “nope, we can't do it. You need to get your electrical connection and water valve updated.” So I had to get a handyman to come out and make the updates. A long story. When I used it, the shortest cycle is 1 hour which doesn't include and drying. That cycle does not do the job. So I've had to use the 2.5 hour cycle…I found that the dishes do not get thoroughly washed so matter how I arrange the dishes and change the settings. I never had to try this hard with my old dishwasher. I am hoping to return this machine and find something else with a better design. My previous dishwasher was a Kenmore. It ran great for 21 years with no problems. However, the color was almond. Comments (English): [ High-end appliance with the performance to match. ] || ---------------- || As I already have an LG washing machine, I was very much looking forward to using this LG dishwasher.The LG DF455HMS dishwasher is a high-end appliance which shows in the design, looks and feature set. It is part of the LG QuadWash series which uses fours spray arms to enhance the washing performance. This model is also equipped with LG's TrueSteam technology, which uses hot steam to sanitise dishes, eliminate bacteria and odours. The dishwasher according to the advertisement has enough room for 15 place settings, which is ideal for larger families and one's like mine which seem to use more dishes and cutlery than most other families twice the size.From the moment it arrived I was impressed; the packaging was well thought out and I feel plastic and non-recyclable materials were minimised. Before use, there is a small amount of prep which included, removing tear off film from the internal drawers, some foam spacers and fitting some rubber trim and additional sound deadening. Also if you have a porous worktop there was some tape supplied to install and prevent steam damage to the underside of the worktop (door pops open at the end of the cycle to help the drying process, this can be switched off). This again was an easy process as you can either look it up on the water companies website or use the included water hardness test strip.Smart app setup is super easy and as I already had the app installed it detected the dishwasher seconds after pressing the Wi-Fi button. A nice touch was the dishwasher seemed to be automatically registered on my account and registered for warranty, as I received an email shortly after. There are a large number of features that can be turned on/off and you can also download 'new' cycles from within the app if there is something else you need over and above the standard ones.All in all, this is a fantastic dishwasher that not only does the job superbly but also is super quiet and satisfies the techie part of my life. Now what other LG appliances can get for the home? Pro's • Quiet.• Great cleaning ability.• Easy to use.• Stylish.• 'Smart' with ability to integrate into Home Automation systems.Cons• The very top trim is plastic and scratches quite easily.• Requires a little assembly at install.

Comments (English): [ FreeFlex Third Level Rack KA models are the BEST! ] || ---------------- || My 15yr old Kenmore Elite (Whirlpool) was washing intermittently, I think the diverter motor or washer motor was the problem since it filled and drained fine just sometimes the spray arms would not rotate during the cycle. so weather to repair or replace was the question. I am a long time Whirlpool appliance fan (Kitchenaid, Whirlpool, Maytag, Kenmore etc) and most recently always opt for Kitchenaid. Bosh also gets some of the top dishwasher reviews, but my choice ultimately was the FreeFlex Third Level Rack KA models, and the Presidents Day sales brought some decent pricing; ABT even gives Vets another $50 off, beating HomeDepot, Lowes, Costco, and Kitchenaid.com (which gives vets 25% off MRSP, and free installation and delivery depending on where you live) themselves. I think everyone uses the same drop shipping so just go with who ever delivers free in a timely manner; the installation is hit or miss in the reviews and may best be done yourself if you can. In my case in FL last mile delivery was a big yellow truck from JB Hunt about a week after ordering. The box was brought inside and placed conveniently in my kitchen. This Youtube/Whirlpool video titled: Dishwasher Installation (2020 redesign)  made the task easy; DW was delivered at noon and installed by me, a 77 yr old homeowner in a few hours. I am the official bottle washer too, so was really frustrated with the intermittent operation of the old DW. I decided to get KDTM704KPS with the LED Interior Lighting, better SatinGlide® Max Rails in Third and Middle Racks, Fan-Enabled ProDry System, & Culinary Caddy Utensil Basket since it just wasn't that much more than the KDTM404KPS model. I was a bit reluctant about the LED lighting since I like to leave the DW door open a crack while loading and would prefer the lights either to go off after a few minutes, or only on when the door is completely open. I even questioned, and got the answer that they could be either ON or OFF in the settings menu. well after installing I am happy to report the lighting does go off by itself after 10 minutes like all the new car headlights. That said so far this is an impressive machine, it has a huge interior, and well laid out to clean water catching cups and glasses laying on their sides and neat hooks for the stemware, and that big removable utensil tray on top is a great feature. The thing is really an overkill for two old people, we'll likely go 4-5 days between loads no matter what Cascade commercials say; their DW detergent is great though, and glasses and flatware always sparkle. My old Kenmore Elite was well insulated as well, so I can't rave about how quiet this model is, but like the old one you hardly know it is running, but unlike the old one that was too quiet at times when it spray arms were not rotating, this one has some nice splashing sounds that let you know cleaning action is occurring. it does not disappoint!

Sentence (English): First of all, I am satisfied with purchasing a new product at a good promotional price through the new product launch commemorative experience group event.
Comments (English): [ First of all, at a good promotional price through the new product launch commemorative experience group event. ] || ---------------- || First of all, I am satisfied with purchasing a new product at a good promotional price through the new product launch commemorative experience group event. I was worried about another company's True Steam, but after hearing from acquaintances about the disadvantages caused by high temperatures, I was looking at Samsung dishwasher models. I paid. In the case of the panel to suit the needs of the customer, it was nice to have a wide range of colors to choose from, and the size for 14 people, which increased space utilization, was also satisfactory. In the case of our house, most of the home appliances are Samsung, so as we bought with confidence in the brand, the pre-inspection team and product installation technicians were all considerate of their time and kindly provided a very satisfactory service, from appointments to explanations after installation. Like a bespoke product, the design also upgrades the atmosphere of the house. The downside is that it's the first dishwasher and it's not used a few times, so I don't have it so far, but I think I'll have to try it a little more.
Comments (Original): [ 우선 신제품 런칭 기념 체험단 이벤트 통해 좋은 프로모션 가격으로... ] || ---------------- || 우선 신제품 런칭 기념 체험단 이벤트 통해 좋은 프로모션 가격으로 신제품 구매하게 되어 만족스럽습니다. 타사 트루 스팀도 고민하였지만, 높은 고온으로 인한 단점도 주변 지인들에게 듣고 알게 된 후 삼성 식기세척기 모델을 살피던 와중에 23년 신제품의 경우 중국 생산 ODM이 아닌 삼성 공장에서 생산된 제품이라 한치의 고민 없이 즉시 결제하였습니다. 고객의 니즈에 맞게 판넬의 경우 색상 선택이 폭이 많아 좋았고, 공간활용도를 높인 14인용 사이즈도 만족 스럽습니다. 저희집의 경우 대부분 가전이 삼성이라 브랜드 믿고 구매 한 만큼 사전점검팀이 나 제품 설치 기사님 모두 시간 배려해 주시고 친절하게 약속, 설치 후 설명까지 아주 만족스러운 서비스로 진행해 주셨습니다.  비스포크 제품답게 디자인도 집안 분위기를 한층 업그레이드해주네요, 제품 소음도 예상보다 크지 않으며 세척력 또한 기대 이상으로 좋은 것 같습니다. 단점은 식기세척기가 처음이며 사용 횟수가 몇번 되지 않아 현재까진 없으나 조금 더 사용해보아야 할 것 같습니다.

The bottom rack does not have squared corners, so you cannot completely fill the rack. They also removed traditional rows of tines in favor of larger useless spaces on the rack, supposedly for pots or pans, but meaning you cannot fill every space in the rack with glasses or bowls or Non-pots and pans, like you could on all previous dishwashers. The Energy Star aspect is useless if you have to run the dishwasher Twice because you couldn't add more dishes to fill the load even though there was space, just no tines to place things on. Poor front controls, the washer controls light up every time you open it, instead of waiting for you to actually set the cycle and turn it on. That is a waste of electricity. There is no Drain option to manually empty the unit, or drain it after the cycle finishes. It is also a louder dishwasher and takes a long time to complete a cycle. If we did not pay so much to have this "new" but lesser quality dishwasher hooked up, we would have returned it. It is a regrettable purchase.

Sentence (English): I have been waiting for years for my old dishwasher to die so I could justify buying a Bosch!
Comments (English): [ Just ok ] || ---------------- || I have been waiting for years for my old dishwasher to die so I could justify buying a Bosch! I had heard sooo many good things! However, I am pretty disappointed in the results. I often find little bits of food still on my silverware, glass Pyrex, sometimes bowls, etc. My glassware is looking more streaky than before and my bottle nipples have become more yellowed. I thought I was doing something wrong and have watched lots of tutorials from the Bosch site. It improved things marginally, but I had still hoped for better! I truthfully felt things were often cleaner with my old dishwasher. I use dishwasher pods (have tried 2 brands), used the recommended Finish jet-dry, and run my dishwasher daily (on average). Any other suggestions are welcomed!

Sentence (English): My wife has terrible eyesight, which means her other senses have had to compensate, resulting in her having an incredible sense of smell.
Comments (English): [ Simply great ] || ---------------- || My wife has terrible eyesight, which means her other senses have had to compensate, resulting in her having an incredible sense of smell. This new dishwasher (and in particular its auto-open function) has made a tangible difference in how the dishes smell post-wash. No more rinsing the dishes! This alone makes it a recommendable product.Aside from that it has a lot of seemingly very simple but incredibly useful features, like being able to easily adjust the height of the second drawer to fit larger glasses (though our plates are quite big so we've had to play around a bit to get boththe big plates and large wine glasses in! ). Also being able to change the spacing bewteen the prongs to allow for different load types really makes a difference when washing pots/pans as well as normall dishes, cutlery etc.And of course, it washes really well. My wife was suspicious of the cutlery drawer being at the top but they washed two day old dried-on food perfectly so she's a convert.Some of the noises are a bit ridiculous (what's wrong with a good old-fashioned beep? ) but they can be switched off so it's fine.It's reasonably quiet but not silent, but thats hardly that black mark as it's still better than my previous machine.

Sentence (English): I have several LG appliances so was prepared for the high quality that I have come to expect from the brand.
Comments (English): [ Does what you expect a dishwasher to do! ] || ---------------- || I have several LG appliances so was prepared for the high quality that I have come to expect from the brand. The dishwasher has a smart finish to the exterior, however it would be nice if the buttons were hidden inside the top of the door as they are with some of LGs other freestanding models. There is a wide range of cycles to chose from, with more available to download via the ThinQ app. Most of the cycles take a long time to complete, presumably down to the energy and water efficiency and the fact it actually does a good job at cleaning heavily soiled dishes. The steam function does a good job of cleaning and leaving a good finish however I have found that the items washed on a steam cycle come out quite wet even if on an 'extra dry' setting. The smart wifi features aren't anything to rave about. You can download one extra cycle from ThinQ app to the machine and it'll tell you how long left whilst running. No remote start features etc. It is however the easiest way to set the water hardness settings and rinse aid dose amount. The app will also tell you how many cycles have been run so you know when to clean the machine (every 30). This is also displayed by an LED on the dishwasher though. Overall a good quality, good looking machine that does a good job of washing dishes!

Sentence (English): I've been living without a dishwasher for a while, but since everyone's talking about new ones, I figured I should get one, even if it's late.
Comments (English): [ The product is good and the installation was done well. ] || ---------------- || I've been living without a dishwasher for a while, but since everyone's talking about new ones, I figured I should get one, even if it's late. My new, older apartment has a built-in dishwasher. I tried running it on the sterilizer, but it was noisy and made a rubber bullet sound. I didn't want to use it, so I searched online. It was on sale on Coupang and had great reviews, so I bought it without even comparing. I usually compare a lot, but I just went with this one. I bought it for around 750,000 won. Two days after ordering, a technician came and installed it neatly. After using it for two days, I'm satisfied so far. Pros: 1. Time savings. I can spend less time standing at the sink doing dishes and more time doing other things. My biggest reason was that I wanted to spend more time playing with my only son. I plan to spend more time with him because he's always bored. (I really need to practice this.) 2. It's good for hygiene because it sterilizes and disinfects. It's definitely cleaner and more squeaky-clean than when I do it by hand. And since it dries, I feel like a very clean housewife. ^^. 3. Saves water and electricity. They say it saves more water than just leaving the faucet on all the time. I think you need to compare your water and electricity bills on this one. 4. Reduces the mental burden of washing dishes. Even with a lot of dishes, I still have a dishwasher. 5. I really like the simple, sophisticated design and beige color. 6. The installer was perfect. He installed it neatly and even removed the existing built-in appliances. He even explained how to use it, so I didn't have to look at the manual. Cons: I've only used it for two days, so I'm still not very good at arranging the dishes. It'll take some time to get used to it. Comments (English): [ Zero help if any problems with delivery ] || ---------------- || We ordered a dishwasher from Costco despite reading the many reviews detailing the horrible process between delivery and installation. Specially, buyers mentioned the terrible customer service from Costco. I can report this is very accurate. We ordered our dishwasher and were provided a delivery date of 1-16-23. Because I had read the reviews I called Costco on 1-13-23 when we had not received a call from the delivery people indicating the time the dishwasher would be delivered. I was assured by a supervisor that it was coming 1-16-23 in the A.M. I insured I would not have to work and sat at home waiting. When the truck arrived, the installer asked me where the dishwasher was. I thought he was joking. I told him on his truck. Nope. He did not have the dishwasher and he told me this was the third time this had occurred where he had showed up at someone's house, and they had been told that Costco would be delivering the dishwasher only do not have the dishwasher at the home. He called his warehouse. He called a supervisor. He tried diligently to locate our dishwasher to no avail. Meanwhile, I called Costco customer service where I dealt with the rudest representative I have experienced in my life she was a supervisor and was beyond not helpful. She continued to tell me that despite a supervisor on 1-13-23 telling me that our dishwasher would be here on one 1-16-23 that it was a holiday and there was absolutely nothing she could do about it. She was rude, condescending and honestly, horrible. I asked for her supervisor which she would not provide. I received an email later saying now the unit would be delivered on 1-18-23 which meant another day insuring I would not have to work. The dishwasher was delivered on 1-18-23. This time they sent a warehouse supervisor out who was amazing. She waited while the dishwasher was installed and told me if I had any issues to email her. I told her what a frustrating experience this had been and how poor the customer service was. She indicated that she had received this feedback previously from other customers and she wanted to insure I received my product. I can honestly say that I would not ever order an appliance from Costco again due to the amount of hassle and stress the experience caused. The local warehouse manager was outstanding but the many calls and e-mails I had to send prior to dealing with her with rude or zero response outweighed her amazing service. Buyer beware.

At the end of a cycle, food particles are stuck in bowls, and pieces of silverware are visibly dirty when the cycle is finished. I visually inspect each item before putting the dishes away, and there are always at least a few items that need to be rewashed by hand. Items are not overlapping each other when placed in the dishwasher, so I'm at a loss as to why items are not clean at the end of a cycle.

Sentence (English): I bought this over a year ago from Nebraska Furniture Mart, mainly for the 39 dBA noise rating but also for my respect for Kitchen Aid, and the Retailer's promise that the unit was in-stock and would be delivered & installed within 2 weeks despite the supply-chain problems at that time.
Comments (English): [ Kitchen Aid will not replace damaged unit ] || ---------------- || I bought this over a year ago from Nebraska Furniture Mart, mainly for the 39 dBA noise rating but also for my respect for Kitchen Aid, and the Retailer's promise that the unit was in-stock and would be delivered & installed within 2 weeks despite the supply-chain problems at that time. Instead, it took nearly 4 months to get delivered, and when it arrived it was damaged, only I didn't realize it at the time because the damage was under the unit toward the back. The tub was slowly leaking for 5 months, damaging the floor and finished basement walls below. When I noticed the damage and realized it was due to a leak under the dishwasher, I called the retailer immediately. It took 3 months for them to finally tell me they would not replace it, citing a 30-day-from-delivery policy. They referred me to the 1-year manufacturer warranty. KitchenAid says they will “repair” under warranty, but will not replace the unit. That means they will remove all the operating parts from the damaged tub (the tub is main body, which is cracked and that's where it leaks) and reassemble all the parts onto a new tub, at my house - not at the factory. It will no longer be a factory sealed and Quality-Controlled unit, and therefore the 39 dBA noise rating will also be void. I paid over $1000, for a new, undamaged, super-quiet dishwasher, and waited over a year, sustained damage to the wall and floor finishes of my house, and in the end I have a “Frankenstein” re-build with no factory QC or rating. I feel like I have been robbed.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher for one of our rentals.
Comments (English): [ Rental Unit Level of Quality ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher for one of our rentals. Just be aware that in a quiet room this dishwasher is not quiet, regardless of what the manufacturer wants you to think. 55 dB is somewhat loud. While you won't be able to hear the motor, there will be loud water sloshing noises. And if you have a large cooking pot on the bottom rack, you'll hear it loudly as the water jets pass into the pot cavity. The water filling the tub sounds loud, tooAs for cleaning, it does an ok job, but does not make your dishes look polished like more costly dishwashers do. The steaming cycle makes a slight whining noise some might find annoying. And for those that don't read the instructions, they might think the dishwasher is broken when it starts the steaming cycle, because despite the whining- buzzing noise some can hear during the steam cycle, others will hear nothing.Other pet peeves. It lacks a rinse and hold Cycle. Time delay is 3, 6 or 9 hours. That's it. You can't delay start time for 1, 2, 7,12 hours, etc. 3,6 or 9 hours are your only options.The metal finish is somewhat hard to clean and polish. I coated mine with Vaseline to protect it because it is not high quality metal and looks like it is susceptible to rusting. So if you live on the beach, beware.

The automatic water open function of the LG Dios dishwasher is really good. In my case, I use the dishwasher and check it the next morning. If you check right away, the watermelon is not dry because of the heat and water vapor. If you check the next day, the dishes are really fluffy :) So it's best to put them back before bed and sleep. Hot air drying is added to the newly released dishwasher. I think it's a function that I coveted more~^^ And if there's one more tip, I use a detergent that has both detergent and rinse function. All-in-one detergent is so convenient and good for me. It may be possible, but our time is precious, so I prefer an all-in-one detergent that is easy to use. And I prefer a tablet-type detergent. If you use a dishwasher, you can't wash the same amount of dishes every day. I put only half of it. On days when the amount is small, you don't have to use all of the detergent. I don't know if it will help, but I wrote down my own tips. ;After participating in the event, newly released products stand out. I want to replace the dishwasher with a new model of the LG DIOS dishwasher. The daily temperature difference is severe. Be careful not to catch a cold. I hope you have a good day. Good job^^
